name: lumenhold-academy
description: A swipe-card life simulation at a magical academy, with content in Grimoire Script (.grim).

scripts.sim:social: sh tools/with-node24.sh node tools/grim.js sim 300 --policy social
scripts.sim:zh: sh tools/with-node24.sh node tools/grim.js sim 300 --lang zh-CN
scripts.i18n:zh: sh tools/with-node24.sh node tools/grim.js i18n zh-CN
scripts.verify: sh tools/with-node24.sh sh -c 'node tools/version.js --check && node tools/grim.js build --check && node tools/grim.js lint && node tools/grim.js fmt --check && node tools/grim.js docs --check && node --test test/*.test.js && node tools/grim.js balance --quick && node tools/grim.js diff && node tools/e2e.js --server --quick'
